subject: Textures delta complete: Vk83, mip/layer spans, sampler parity, 804 checks
body: Textures delta (Claude root) implemented/host-tested. 1) VkFormat83: n2r case83 (207<<12)|16 matches vertex_fetch half2; new test compares full ATTRIBUTE descriptor words0..4 to independent v9 pan_cast_and_pack, stride4, word5..7 zero. 2) Mip/layer transport: helper tests 5-level 2D, 3 layers x4 levels, cube6x3, 3D depth4x3, level>16/layer>2048/subresource>256 refusals. Exact compute calls: fill layout.level[0..levels-1] view-relative; n2t_layout_check(l,0,declared_span); n2t_layout_pack_sampled/storage(l,base,declared_span,desc_va,payload_va,payload,cap,&packed) writes all layers x levels layer-major/level-minor; or n2t_layout_subresource+n2t_plane_pack per entry. Do not use level0 row*height surrogate. Compute TDG2 still refuses levels>1 and 16-plane bound is compute-owned. 3) Sampler parity: compare only depth view (color compare -15); depth compare tested; depth border refuses; integer views require nearest/no-linear-mip/aniso1, raw uint32 border for integer; custom float border/presets/LOD/aniso tested. Gradients are shader/NIR, not a sampler field, no descriptor claim. 4) Helper 804 checks PASS release+ASan/UBSan; n2r suite PASS release+ASan including Vk83; existing oracle PASS. Hash list in STATUS.md. Remaining cross-owner: compute mip wire>1/16-plane bound, bridge explicit zero-RRRR validity and view-format sampler, render fixed/compositor sampler guards and exact factory. No phone/build/commit/publish.
